nodes.question: How can advanced technologies like AI and IoT improve waste management in the denim industry?
nodes.answer: Advanced technologies like AI and IoT can optimize waste management in the denim industry by monitoring and managing waste flows and environmental impact in real time, making the analysis more efficient and precise.
